episodes.title: Connection
episodes.summary: Dong-soo loses an eye to an organ hunter, and is then connected to the vision of a corpse artist.

episodes.title: Conjunction
episodes.summary: Dong-soo chases the corpse art killer with whom his vision is connected.

episodes.title: Composition
episodes.summary: Dong-soo becomes a murder suspect, while the killer is now aware of Dong-soo.

episodes.title: Confession
episodes.summary: Dong-soo tells his secret to Detective Choi, and I-rang tells Dong-soo the truth. Jin-seop sets a trap.

episodes.title: Concoction
episodes.summary: Odds are stacked against Dong-soo as he tries to rescue Z and the junkyard owner from Jin-seop.

episodes.title: Confusion
episodes.summary: I-rang and Detective Choi set out to Jin-seop's atelier but their conflicting interests stir up chaos.
